name: antimagic_square_n6_seed43791__v1_nh
prompt:
Construct an antimagic square of order 6: an n×n grid filled with the integers 1..36 (each used exactly once) such that the 14 line sums (n rows, n cols, both main diagonals) form 14 CONSECUTIVE integers (all distinct, with max - min = 13).

Return the grid + sums as a flat list of 50 integers: first 36 are the grid (row-major; cell (i,j) at index i*6+j), next 14 are the sums (rows 0..5, then cols 0..5, then main diagonal, then anti-diagonal). State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such square exists.
